counterfactual_missing_items: details on the duration of denosumab use prior to fracture
comparison of bone mineral density with previous measurements
decisive_items: an incomplete transverse fracture in the lateral cortex of the right femoral neck
had received denosumab for osteoporosis for five years
T2-weighted magnetic resonance imaging demonstrated a high-signal bend in the same region
response.rationale: R2 is the champion due to its comprehensive support from multiple raw spans, including fracture description, denosumab use, and imaging findings. C1, although related, lacks the breadth of evidence and is considered an append-only completion of R2.

rejected.why: narrow focus on denosumab etiology without comprehensive fracture description
